reason: I already pay for Calm and I'm used to it, and my AirPods already cut the sound once I'm out. I might grab the free 14 days since there's no auto-pay, but I'm not paying for a second sleep app on my salary.
objection: I work shifts and sleep at weird hours, sometimes in the daytime, so I doubt a morning 10-second check can tune anything to me. And the part where it picks up the sound automatically when I wake needs an armband that doesn't come until 2028, so right now it's just a lock-screen button.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day record actually showed I fall asleep noticeably faster than with Calm, and I could drop Calm so I'm paying for one app, not two.
